verdict.rationale: Asana documents its own in-product AI: pre-built AI agents and AI Teammates that work inside workflows with context from the Work Graph, plus 'Asana Dash' billed as an 'AI Chief of Staff.' However, no evidence describes these features producing insights or suggestions from a user's data. The MCP server's 'reports and summaries' run in external AI clients like Claude and ChatGPT, not inside Asana, so they get no credit. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of in-product AI-generated insights or suggestions on project data (e.g., summaries, risk flags, recommendations), detail on what Asana Dash actually surfaces, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Pre-built AI agents that work alongside your team inside real workflows, with shared memory, governance, and context from the Work Graph
Shared memory means AI Teammates learn from the work itself.
